title: How is a stop payment placed or renewed on a Personal Checking check?
content:
## Scope

This policy governs stop payment orders and their renewals on paper checks written on a Personal Checking account. Stops on ACH debits and on official checks are outside this policy.

## Placing an order

1. **What an order covers.** A stop payment order covers one paper check, identified by the check number and the exact amount the customer states; the payee is recorded as the customer states it.
2. **Tier.** Stop payment orders are available only on a tier on which paper checks can be written, as shown by the account's tier.
3. **Unpaid checks only.** A stop payment can be placed only on a check that has not already been paid. A check counts as paid when the account shows a paid-check debit with the same check number.
4. **No second order.** A second order on a check that already has an unexpired order is not placed; the existing order is renewed instead.

## Expiry

An order lapses at the end of **6** calendar months after its order date: its expiry date is the order date plus 6 calendar months, falling back to the last day of the month when that day does not exist in the month.

## Renewal

1. An unexpired order may be renewed on or before its expiry date. Count calendar months from the order date of the order being renewed; renewal is allowed while the current date is on or before that order's expiry date, and the expiry date itself still allows renewal.
2. A renewal is a new order linked to the order being renewed, and its expiry date is the renewal's own order date plus 6 calendar months.
3. A lapsed order cannot be renewed; a new order is placed instead if the check is still unpaid.

## Expiry date examples (hypothetical order dates)

| Order date | Expiry date | Why |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-02-10 | 2026-08-10 | Same day, 6 calendar months later |
| 2026-03-31 | 2026-09-30 | September has no 31st, so the last day of September |
| 2025-08-31 | 2026-02-28 | February 2026 has no 31st, so the last day of February |

## Renewal boundary (hypothetical order placed 2026-03-31, expiring 2026-09-30)

| Current date | Renewal allowed? | What follows |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-09-15 | Yes | The renewal expires 6 calendar months after 2026-09-15, on 2027-03-15 |
| 2026-09-30 | Yes | The expiry date itself still allows renewal |
| 2026-10-01 | No | The order has lapsed; if the check is still unpaid a new order is placed instead |

## Basis Q&A

**Q: The check already shows as paid on the account. Can a stop still be placed?**
A: No. A stop payment can be placed only on a check that has not already been paid.

**Q: The customer asks for a stop on a check that already has an unexpired order.**
A: A second order is not placed; the existing order is renewed instead.
